item.title: A Second Seatbelt on Your Wrist, Flower Road
item.description: A wearable solution for preventing road rage. It reads heart rate from a smartwatch while driving to pinpoint the moments accident risk rises, then helps the driver settle down through music, voice guidance, and breathing.

item.title: That Outfit From the Drama, Just Clothes

item.title: Mom's Heart on Your Wrist, Mom's Healing Hands
item.description: A child safety service pairing a child's smartwatch with a parent's phone. Rather than texting a bare address, it judges whether the child's location is safe from public safety data and shows it on Street View, and lets parents guide the child home or to a safe playground.

item.title: Lawmakers' Report Card in Your Hand, Watchbly
item.description: An app built to make the National Assembly legible to a generation that rarely votes. It ranks lawmakers by their legislative activity and opens up each member's committees, terms served, and bills proposed, alongside a channel to petition them by email.
